primary_candidate_metric: mean of within-campaign Spearman correlations, equal campaign weight
source_balanced_sensitivity: average campaigns within source, then equal-weight sources
two_candidate_groups: descriptive pair ordering only; no standalone Spearman reliability claim
measured_ties: average ranks; report fraction of tied pairs; do not jitter
prediction_ties: average ranks; exact prediction ties earn 0.5 in pairwise accuracy
pairwise_secondary: measured-tied pairs excluded from pairwise denominator and their count reported; never treat pairs as independent replicates
constant_measurement_group: Spearman undefined; disclose, do not silently assign zero
constant_prediction_group: Spearman undefined; disclose method coverage failure; pairwise metric still shows tied predictions, never silently remove a method's hard groups
unknown_uncertainty_type: retain undefined; no SD/SEM conversion, uncertainty weighting or invented confidence interval
technical_repeats: not independent biological samples or extra enzyme candidates
dependence: source and global-family blocks retained; calibrate crossed dependence using development-only simulations before selecting an inferential method
bootstrap_status: not approved for confirmatory inference with current small number of source blocks
model_list_and_multiplicity: must freeze comparator versions, common coverage, contrast family and multiplicity handling before predictions
remaining_gates: source quality and campaign inclusion resolved
all existing absolute-protocol readiness gates passed
precision and power assessment with development data or justified simulation
source/family dependence and undefined-score aggregation rule finalized
checkpoint and evaluation manifest hashes frozen
